projectDescription: An AI agent skill that generates single-file HTML horizontal-swipe presentations in a magazine × e-ink aesthetic, featuring WebGL fluid backgrounds, serif/sans/mono typography hierarchy, and 10 ready-to-use slide layouts.
keyFeatures: Single-file HTML output — no build tools or server required, open directly in browser
WebGL fluid/dispersion backgrounds that animate on hero slides and fade on content slides
Three-tier typography system: serif headings (Noto Serif SC + Playfair Display), sans-serif body (Noto Sans SC + Inter), monospace metadata (IBM Plex Mono)
Horizontal swipe navigation with keyboard arrows, scroll wheel, touch swipe, dot indicators, and ESC index view
5 curated preset color themes (Ink Classic, Indigo Porcelain, Forest Ink, Kraft Paper, Dune) — no custom hex values allowed
10 ready-to-paste slide layout skeletons covering cover, act dividers, data stats, quote+image, image grid, pipeline, hero question, big quote, before/after, and lead image
Structured 6-step AI workflow with requirement clarification, class pre-flight checks, and theme rhythm planning
Quality checklist with P0/P1/P2/P3 severity tiers capturing real iteration lessons
publicApiSurface: SKILL.md — agent skill entrypoint with 6-step workflow
assets/template.html — seed HTML file with CSS, WebGL shaders, and navigation JS pre-configured
references/themes.md — 5 :root CSS variable presets for color themes
references/components.md — component usage reference (Typography, Chrome/Foot, Callout, Stat, Platform, Rowline, Pillar, Figure, Icons, Ghost, Highlight)
references/checklist.md — P0–P3 quality checklist for self-review
